description: This file defines a React component 'StatusRefreshButton' for refreshing status data of nodes in a UI. It includes logic for handling refresh actions, updating UI state, and formatting timestamps. It also exports a custom hook for managing optimistic UI updates related to node status.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Handles the refresh button click, triggers API calls to refresh node status based on provided nodeId(s), and manages UI state.

methods.name: getButtonSize
methods.description: Determines button size based on 'size' prop.

methods.name: getIconSize
methods.description: Determines icon size based on 'size' prop.

methods.name: formatLastVerified
methods.description: Formats timestamp of last verification into a human-readable string.
